auth.admin_only: Only the administrator can do this.
auth.setup_done: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
auth.locked: Too many wrong tries. Wait a minute and try again.
users.name_invalid: Use a name of 1 to 40 characters.
users.name_taken: Another profile already has this name.
users.admin_needs_password: Administrators need a password of at least 8 characters.
users.self_demote: You cannot remove your own administrator role.
users.self_delete: You cannot delete the profile you are signed in with.
auth.password_too_short: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
library.invalid_kind: Choose Movies, TV Shows or Other videos.
library.path_invalid: One of the folders does not exist or cannot be read.
library.path_too_broad: Pick the folder that holds your videos, not a whole drive or a system folder.
fs.not_found: That folder does not exist or cannot be read.
match.unsupported: Only movies and shows can be matched. Open the show to fix an episode.
match.no_key: Add a TMDB key in Settings first.
settings.tmdb_invalid: TMDB rejected this key. Check it and try again.
media.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg was not found, so this file cannot be converted for the browser.
media.subtitle_unsupported: This subtitle is an image format and cannot be shown yet. Turn on subtitle OCR in Settings → Languages to read it.
media.subtitle_failed: This subtitle could not be converted.
media.hls_unavailable: This file cannot be streamed as HLS yet: it is not probed, or its keyframe index is still being built. Use the regular stream.
media.transcode_busy: The server is already converting as many videos as allowed. Try again when another stream stops, or raise the limit in Settings → Transcoder.
common.bad_request: The request has a value the server does not accept.
common.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Check the server log.
markers.invalid: A marker must start before it ends, inside the video.
metadata.invalid: Check the values: a title is required, the year 0 to 2200, the rating 0 to 10.
playlists.name_invalid: Use a playlist name of 1 to 80 characters.
playlists.not_owner: Only the profile that made this playlist can change it.
playlists.item_unplayable: Only movies, episodes and videos can go in a playlist.
playlists.too_many: A playlist holds at most 5000 items.
collections.name_invalid: Use a collection name of 1 to 80 characters.
collections.item_invalid: Collections hold movies and shows, not seasons or episodes.
shelves.title_invalid: Use a shelf title of 1 to 80 characters.
auth.home_only: This profile has no PIN, so it only opens on the home network. Ask the administrator to add a PIN to use it away from home.
auth.lan_session: This profile was opened without its PIN at home. Sign in again with the PIN to use it here.
items.content_rating_invalid: Use a rating such as PG-13, TV-14 or 16 (up to 16 characters).
profile.language_invalid: Choose a language from the list.
profile.rating_invalid: Choose an age limit between 0 and 18.
profile.import_invalid: This is not a Kinema profile export, or it is damaged.
profile.lock_invalid: The PIN or password in this file cannot be used for this profile.
shares.expiry_invalid: A link lasts from 1 hour to 90 days.
shares.target_invalid: Only a movie, show, season, episode or video can be shared.
